name: async-select
title: Async select
description: A select that asks your server as you type: debounced, with a loading row, a no-results line that repeats the query and stale answers dropped.
docs: loadOptions(query, signal) resolves with the options; pass the signal to fetch. Each new question aborts the one before it and a late answer is dropped, so an old answer can never replace a new one. value is the chosen option itself, so the field names it before anything has loaded. defaultOptions lists options before anything is typed (or true to ask the loader with an empty text), minChars and debounce set when it asks, and clearable adds a button that clears the choice and hands the focus to the field. A quick answer just swaps the list; a slow one shows a loading row. The list keeps one minimum height, so the loading row, the 'No results for acme' line and the error line with Retry never move anything under the input. messages replaces the words.
